hypotheses.justification: Split on SFinite ν. In the s-finite case, install the instance and use the existing proof. Otherwise, Measure.prod is defined to be zero for every left measure, so both products vanish. The remaining equality is 0 = c • 0, which follows from the scalar tower: c • 0 = (c • 1) * 0 = 0, also for infinite scalars. This argument also covers empty underlying types.
